metadata.title: RDSO Railway Track Canonical Knowledge Core

entities.label: RDSO/T-6154 (1:12 Turnout)
entities.desc: Master Layout of 1 in 12 Turnout 60 kg (UIC) on PSC Sleepers (64 sleepers total).

entities.label: RDSO/T-6155 (Curved Switch)
entities.desc: 10125 mm Curved Switch with ZU-1-60/60E1A1 Thick-Web Tongue Rails on PSC Sleepers.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6216 (SSD Assembly)
entities.desc: Spring Setting Device (SSD) for Thick-Web Switches at Sleeper 13 (JOH).

entities.label: RDSO/T-6280 (CMS Crossing)
entities.desc: 1 in 12 Cast Manganese Steel (CMS) Crossing assembly with special bearing plates.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6275 (Check Rails)
entities.desc: Check Rail arrangement (5000 mm) with flared ends for 60 kg UIC turnout.

entities.label: RDSO/T-9010 (Detail 'B' Forging)
entities.desc: Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar manufacturing and forging drawing clearing S&T Clamp Lock.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 10 (Welded Joint W)
entities.desc: Eliminated fatigue-prone Machined Joint 'M' and standardized Welded Joint 'W' for thick web tongue rails.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 11 (222 mm Drop)
entities.desc: Mandated 222 mm drop bend on Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar to clear S&T Clamp Point Lock drive rod.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 12 (Note 25/26 Dowels)
entities.desc: Standardized epoxy retrofit protocol for sleeper dowel hole repairs at Sleepers 3 and 4.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 13 (LIST-A 10% Spares)
entities.desc: Mandated 10% inventory procurement buffer across all 24 wear and breakage components in LIST-A.

entities.label: RDSO/T-6154 Alt 06 (Turnout Layout)
entities.desc: Master layout harmonization matching 60 kg UIC 64-sleeper schedule with thick-web switch and CMS crossing.

entities.label: NOTE 1: Switch Design Scope
entities.desc: Specifies that drawing covers 10125 mm curved switch with thick web tongue rails for 1 in 12 turnout on PSC sleepers.

entities.label: NOTE 4: Rail Lengths & Throw
entities.desc: Mandates stock rail length 13000 mm, tongue rail length 12480 mm, and 160 mm throw of switch at toe (sleeper 3).

entities.label: NOTE 12: Welded Joint 'W'
entities.desc: Mandates Welded Joint 'W' for thick web tongue rails, explicitly eradicating failure-prone Machined Joint 'M'.

entities.label: NOTE 21: Detail 'B' 222 mm Drop
entities.desc: Mandates that Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar must have 222 mm drop bend to clear Point Machine locking rods.

entities.label: NOTE 25: Dowel Hole Core Repair
entities.desc: Specifies procedure for drilling 35 mm dia x 165 mm depth core hole in concrete sleeper when inserts are missing.

entities.label: NOTE 26: Epoxy L-100 Injection
entities.desc: Mandates injection of Epoxy L-100 (IS:12994) for dowel bonding with mandatory 24-hour curing time before load.

entities.label: NOTE 28: LIST-A 10% Spares Buffer
entities.desc: Mandates 10% quantity procurement buffer across all 24 wear/breakage spare parts listed in LIST-A table.

entities.label: NOTE 6154-1: 64 Sleeper Arrangement
entities.desc: Layout encompasses 64 prestressed concrete turnout sleepers spaced at nominal 600 mm centers.

entities.label: NOTE 6154-7: Site Curve Checking
entities.desc: Mandates pre-laying versine verification over 12480 mm chord: 33 mm at C/4, 44 mm at mid-point C/2, 33 mm at 3C/4.

entities.label: NOTE 6154-11: Fastener Quantities
entities.desc: Specifies exact turnout fastener counts: 347 Elastic Rail Clips Mk-V and 146 Grooved Rubber Sole Plates (10 mm).

entities.label: ZU-1-60 Thick-Web Tongue Rail
entities.desc: Asymmetric thick-web curved tongue rail (12480 mm) providing robust flange guidance.

entities.label: 60 kg (UIC) Stock Rail (13000 mm)
entities.desc: Full section 60 kg UIC standard stock rail machined to receive thick-web tongue rail toe.

entities.label: Cast Steel Slide Chair (T-9616)
entities.desc: Elevated machined slide table supporting ZU-1-60 tongue rail across Sleepers 4 to 20.

entities.label: Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar (T-9010)
entities.desc: Forged M.S. tie bar connecting tongue rail to Point Machine with 222 mm drop bend.

entities.label: Clamp Point Lock Machine (S-3454)
entities.desc: S&T interlocking point machine locking tongue rail directly to stock rail with SIL-4 integrity.

entities.label: Spring Setting Device (T-6216)
entities.desc: Helical pre-compressed spring mechanism maintaining 60 mm dynamic heel clearance at JOH (Sleeper 13).

entities.label: 1 in 12 CMS Monoblock Crossing (T-6279)
entities.desc: Austenitic 12-14% manganese steel monoblock body with work-hardening wear properties.

entities.label: Check Rail Flangeway Guard (T-6275)
entities.desc: 5000 mm machined check rail with 89 mm flared ends maintaining 44 mm flangeway gap.

entities.label: Elastic Rail Clip Mk-V (T-5919)
entities.desc: Heavy duty 23 mm diameter spring steel elastic rail clip delivering 1200-1500 kgf toe load.

entities.label: 10 mm Grooved Rubber Sole Plate (T-3711)
entities.desc: High-attenuation 10 mm grooved elastomeric pad insulating rails and damping 25t dynamic impacts.

entities.label: PSC Turnout Sleeper (T-4219)
entities.desc: High-strength prestressed concrete turnout sleeper with recessed canted rail seats and SGCI dowels.

entities.label: Approach Zone (Sleepers 1-3)
entities.desc: Lead-in track section transitioning from standard open track into switch toe.

entities.label: Switch Zone (Sleepers 4-20)
entities.desc: Curved switch zone equipped with 34 slide chairs and SSD at Sleeper 13.

entities.label: Intermediate Lead Curve (Sleepers 21-42)
entities.desc: Lead curve track zone transitioning switch radius (441.36 m) towards crossing.

entities.label: CMS Crossing Zone (Sleepers 43-55)
entities.desc: Crossing assembly zone housing 1:12 CMS crossing and 5000 mm check rails.

entities.label: Exit Transition Zone (Sleepers 56-64)
entities.desc: Exit diverging and straight track zone returning to standard track sleeper length.

entities.label: Sleeper 03 (Toe & Point Machine)
entities.desc: Point machine mounting station supporting switch toe and Detail 'B' bent tie bar.

entities.label: Sleeper 13 (Junction of Head - JOH)
entities.desc: JOH station housing Spring Setting Device (SSD) maintaining 60 mm flangeway gap.

entities.label: Sleeper 48 (Theoretical Nose of Crossing)
entities.desc: TNC station where turnout gauge lines intersect; maximum axle dynamic impact location.

entities.label: Switch Throw: 160 mm at Toe
entities.desc: Mandatory opening stroke of tongue rail at toe (Sleeper 3) ensuring unobstructed wheel flange clearance.

entities.label: JOH Heel Flangeway Gap: 60 mm
entities.desc: Minimum dynamic gap between tongue rail and stock rail at Junction of Head (Sleeper 13).

entities.label: Tie Bar Drop: 222 mm
entities.desc: Downward forged offset on Detail 'B' bent tie bar clearing S&T Clamp Lock drive rods.

entities.label: Check Rail Flangeway: 44 mm
entities.desc: Critical safety flangeway clearance between running rail and check rail guarding the crossing nose.

entities.label: Fastener Toe Load: 1200-1500 kgf
entities.desc: Clamping force exerted by ERC Mk-V spring clip preventing longitudinal rail creep and gauge widening.

entities.label: Epoxy Core Hole: 35 mm Dia x 165 mm
entities.desc: Precision cored hole dimensions for in-situ sleeper dowel retrofit specified in Note 25.

entities.label: ZU-1-60 / 60E1A1 Thick-Web Steel
entities.desc: High-tensile asymmetric pearlitic rail steel with 880 MPa UTS and deep web inertia.

entities.label: Cast Steel Grade 230-450W (IS: 1030)
entities.desc: Weldable cast carbon steel providing impact toughness and wear resistance for slide chairs.

entities.label: Forged Mild Steel Grade E250 (IS: 2062)
entities.desc: Ductile structural steel allowing hot-forging of 222 mm drop bend without brittle fracture.

entities.label: Epoxy Resin L-100 (IS: 12994)
entities.desc: Two-part structural epoxy mortar achieving >65 kN tensile pull-out strength in 24 hours.

entities.label: Austenitic Manganese Steel (IRS: T 29)
entities.desc: Hadfield steel (12-14% Mn, 1.2% C) work-hardening from 220 BHN to 350 BHN under wheel impact.

entities.label: IRS: T 10 (Curved Switches Specification)
entities.desc: Indian Railway Standard specification governing manufacturing, tolerances, and inspection of curved switches.

entities.label: IRS: T 29 (CMS Crossings Specification)
entities.desc: Indian Railway Standard specification governing cast manganese steel crossings, radiographic tests, and metallurgy.

entities.label: BOM Item: 347x ERC Mk-V (T-5919)
entities.desc: Bill of Materials entry for 347 elastic rail clips securing turnout running rails.

entities.label: BOM Item: 146x GRSP 10mm (T-3711)
entities.desc: Bill of Materials entry for 146 grooved rubber sole plates cushioning turnout rail seats.

entities.label: LIST-A Spare: Bolts 25x310 (T-11526)
entities.desc: Item 1 of LIST-A: 25 mm dia x 310 mm high-tensile bolt subject to dynamic shear in switch.

entities.label: LIST-A Spare: Split Pins 6.3x50 (T-10672)
entities.desc: Item 12 of LIST-A: 6.3 mm split cotter pin preventing tie bar pin loss under vibration.

entities.label: LIST-A Spare: Nylon Bush (T-11516)
entities.desc: Item 19 of LIST-A: electrical insulating nylon sleeve isolating track circuit signaling current.

entities.label: Machined Joint 'M' Fatigue Crack
entities.desc: High stress-concentration fracture at machined rail web notch under 25t heavy freight axle hunting loads.

entities.label: Tongue Rail Toe Chipping
entities.desc: Wheel flange back-strike chipping thin toe profile when throw is <160 mm or slide chairs lack lubrication.

entities.label: CMS Crossing Nose Flow & Battering
entities.desc: Plastic deformation and metal flow at Actual Nose of Crossing (ANC) under dynamic wheel transfer impact.

entities.label: Sleeper Dowel Insert Stripping
entities.desc: SGCI dowel thread stripping in concrete sleepers under tie bar vertical vibration.

entities.label: Facing Point Wheel Flange Splitting
entities.desc: Catastrophic derailment hazard where wheel flange enters between stock rail and tongue rail toe.

entities.label: Point Machine Drive Rod Collision
entities.desc: Physical mechanical collision between straight tie bar and S&T Clamp Lock drive rod preventing point detection.

entities.label: SOP: Sleeper Dowel Epoxy Retrofit
entities.desc: Standard operating procedure for core drilling 35x165 mm hole, Epoxy L-100 injection, and 24-hour curing.

entities.label: SOP: LIST-A 10% Spares Inventory Audit
entities.desc: Mandatory procurement procedure verifying that 10% wear/breakage spares buffer is physically verified in store.

entities.label: SOP: Site Pre-Laying Curve Versine Audit
entities.desc: Pre-installation field inspection measuring 33mm, 44mm, 33mm versines on 12480 mm chord.

entities.label: Indian Railways Permanent Way Manual (IRPWM 2024)
entities.desc: Comprehensive statutory regulations for track maintenance, turnout tolerances, inspection schedules, switch and crossing maintenance. (Reprint 2024 incorporating Advance Correction Slips up to ACS 14 (29-07-2026))

specs.Authority: Railway Board, Ministry of Railways, Government of India

entities.label: Manual for Ultrasonic Testing of Rails and Welds (USFD 2026)
entities.desc: Ultrasonic flaw detection protocols for rails, switches, CMS crossings, and thermit welds, defining probe configurations and defect classifications (IMR, OBS, DFWN, DFWO, DFWR). (Revised Edition 2026 with ACS 1 to 4)

specs.Authority: Track Design Directorate / Metallurgical & Chemical Directorate, RDSO Lucknow

entities.label: Manual for Fusion Welding of Rails by Alumino-Thermic Process (2022)
entities.desc: Field execution parameters, joint gaps, preheating, trimming, finishing tolerances, and acceptance testing of Alumino-Thermic (Thermit) rail welds. (Edition 2022)

entities.label: Manual for Flash Butt Welding of Rails (FBW 2022)
entities.desc: Procedures, parameters, finishing tolerances, and testing protocols for stationary and mobile flash butt welding of rails. (Reprint 2022 incorporating Correction Slips up to CS 5)

specs.File: FBW Manual-Reprint 2022- Incorporated up to CS5.pdf

entities.label: Indian Railways Track Machine Manual (TMM)
entities.desc: Mechanized track maintenance guidelines, UNIMAT points & crossing tamping machine operation, S&T coordination, tamping cycles, lift and slew limits. (Revised Edition incorporating Advance Correction Slips up to ACS 10)

specs.File: INDIAN RAILWAYS TRACK MACHINE MANUAL (INCORPORATED UPTO ACS 10)_FINAL.pdf

entities.label: Small Track Machine Manual (STMM 2024)
entities.desc: Specifications, maintenance, and operating SOPs for small track machines including bolt hole chamfering kits, abrasive rail cutters, and hydraulic rail tensors. (Second Edition (Updated May 2024))

specs.Authority: Track Machines & Monitoring Directorate, RDSO Lucknow

entities.label: Maintenance of Switches & Tongue Rails
entities.desc: A tongue rail shall be classified as worn/damaged when: (i) it is chipped/cracked over small lengths aggregating to 200 mm within a distance of 1000 mm from ATS for 1 in 8.5 switches and within 2000 mm from ATS for 1 in 12 and 1 in 16 switches. Chipped length is defined as portio...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 4: Curves, Points and Crossings (Part B)
specs.Key Rule: Max aggregate chipping: 200 mm within 2000 mm from ATS (1:12 switch)

entities.label: Stretcher Bar Clearance & Interlocking Interface
entities.desc: The Stretcher bar connected to the pull rod shall be maintained jointly by the Permanent Way Staff and the Signalling Staff. The gap between the top of the leading stretcher bar and the bottom of the stock rail should be maintained between 1.5 mm to 5.0 mm. All other stretcher ba...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 4: Curves, Points and Crossings (Part B)
specs.Key Rule: Vertical clearance between top of leading stretcher bar and bottom of stock rail: 1.5 mm to 5.0 mm

entities.label: Maintenance of Crossings & Check Rail Clearances
entities.desc: (a) If any damage to nose of crossing is noticed, its cause must be traced, which might be due to tight gauge or due to excessive clearance at the checkrail. (b) To avoid hitting of nose, it shall be ensured that the checkrail clearance should be between 41 to 45 mm for fan-shape...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 4: Curves, Points and Crossings (Part B)
specs.Key Rule: Check rail clearance: 41 mm (min) to 45 mm (max) for fan-shaped turnout

entities.label: Maintenance of Lead Portion & Versine Tolerances
entities.desc: At the time of laying, the correct sleeper spacing should be ensured to achieve correct alignment of the lead curve. During maintenance, stations at 3.0 m intervals should be marked, versines checked, and track attended as necessary. The versine at each station in lead curve and ...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 4: Curves, Points and Crossings (Part B)
specs.Key Rule: Versine measurement station spacing: 3.0 m intervals

entities.label: Reconditioning of Points & Crossings by Welding
entities.desc: Only skilled/highly skilled welder trained and certified by RDSO or nominated Railway Chemist & Metallurgist shall be engaged. Welding Electrodes: Class H3B (minimum 35 GMT service life) and Class H3C (minimum 50 GMT service life), 4 mm diameter from RDSO approved vendors. Electr...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 4: Curves, Points and Crossings (Part B)
specs.Key Rule: Electrode Class: H3B (35 GMT) and H3C (50 GMT), 4 mm diameter

entities.label: Ultrasonic Testing of Tongue Rails in Points & Crossings
entities.desc: Testing of tongue rails of points and crossings shall be divided into 3 zones: Zone-1: Part of tongue rail where full width of rail head is available; covered in normal rail testing using double/single rail tester. Zone-2: Region where scanning by 70° probe is feasible (up to wid...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 10: Ultrasonic Testing of Rails for Fabrication of Points & Crossings
specs.Key Rule: Zone-1 (Full Head): Double Rail Tester (DRT) / Single Rail Tester (SRT) periodic run

entities.label: Ultrasonic Examination of Worn-Out Point & Splice Rails
entities.desc: Prior to reclamation by welding in depot, worn out point and splice rails of 1 in 12 BG crossing shall be ultrasonically tested in dismantled condition (Fig. 26a). Zone-I: Tested using probes in USFD trolley. Zone-II & III: Hand probing with 0° and 70° probes. Acceptance standard...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 11: Ultrasonic Testing Technique of Worn Out Point & Splice Rails
specs.Key Rule: Inspection mode: Dismantled condition prior to hard-facing deposition

entities.label: Ultrasonic Flaw Detection in Alumino-Thermic Welds
entities.desc: Hand probing of AT welds utilizes: 0° 2 MHz (Head/Web), 70° 2 MHz (Head/Foot), 70° 2 MHz SL (Foot Half-Moon defect), 45° 2 MHz (Foot micro-porosity), and 45° Tandem Rig (Lack of fusion). Defect Classification: Initial testing: Flaw echo >= 30% FSH declared DFWN. Periodic testing:...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 8: Procedure for Ultrasonic Testing of AT Welded Rail Joints
specs.Key Rule: Probe suite: 0° 2 MHz, 70° 2 MHz, 70° SL, 45° 2 MHz, 45° Tandem Rig

entities.label: Site Execution Parameters for Alumino-Thermic Welding
entities.desc: Joint gap between rail ends shall be maintained at 25 +/- 1 mm (75 mm for wide gap). Rail ends must be square cut with abrasive rail cutter. Mould alignment: Preheating using compressed air petrol / LPG burner to achieve 950°C to 1000°C. Preheating time: 10 to 12 minutes for 60 k...

specs.Chapter: Section 4: Execution of Joints at Site

entities.label: Finishing Alignment Tolerances for AT Welded Joints
entities.desc: Vertical alignment: +1.0 mm to -0.0 mm at centre of 1.0 m straight edge; +0.4 mm to -0.0 mm at centre of 10 cm straight edge. Lateral alignment: +/- 0.5 mm at centre of 1.0 m straight edge; +/- 0.3 mm at centre of 10 cm straight edge. Finishing of joint top table: +0.3 mm to -0.0...

specs.Key Rule: Vertical tolerance (1 m straight edge): +1.0 mm / -0.0 mm

entities.label: Mechanized Switch Tamping Protocol (UNIMAT)
entities.desc: UNIMAT Points and Crossing Tamping Machine features independent tilting tamping tools and 3-rail lift hooks. Pre-tamping: Joint inspection by SSE/P.Way and SSE/Signal. Disconnect switch rodding and lock bars. Tamping operation: Squeeze pressure maintained at 110 to 120 bar. Maxim...

specs.Chapter: Chapter 2: Tamping of Plain Track and Points & Crossings
specs.Key Rule: Machine type: UNIMAT 2S / 3S / 4S Switch Tamping Machine

entities.label: Bolt Hole Chamfering SOP for Eliminating Star Cracks
entities.desc: Chamfering kit is utilized to chamfer the edges of drilled bolt holes in rail web at 45° angle to a depth of 1.5 to 2.0 mm. This work-hardens the hole periphery, smooths stress concentration points, and prevents star cracking (USFD defect type 135/235). All newly drilled holes in...

entities.label: Check Rail Clearance: 41 - 45 mm
entities.desc: Ensures wheel flange does not strike nose of crossing in fan-shaped turnout

entities.label: Lead Curve Versine: +/- 3 mm
entities.desc: Maintains curvature smoothness on lead curve at 3.0 m stations

entities.label: Leading Stretcher Bar Clearance: 1.5 - 5.0 mm
entities.desc: Prevents mechanical binding between stretcher bar and stock rail foot

entities.label: CMS Crossing Max Vertical Wear: 10 mm
entities.desc: Defines absolute service wear limit for CMS crossing wing rails and nose

entities.label: CMS Reconditioning Wear Limit: 8 mm
entities.desc: Reconditioning threshold on Rajdhani and Shatabdi passenger routes

entities.label: AT Weld Joint Gap: 25 +/- 1 mm
entities.desc: Standard gap required for mould clamping and fusion collar formation

entities.label: Crossing Gauge: -3 mm to +1 mm
entities.desc: Tight track gauge tolerance through crossing portion for smooth high-speed transit

entities.label: Digital USFD Flaw Detector (0°, 70°, 45°)
entities.desc: Digital Ultrasonic Rail & Weld Flaw Detector equipped with 0° (normal), 70° (head/flange), 45° (weld foot), and Tandem Rig probes.

entities.label: UNIMAT Points & Crossing Tamper
entities.desc: Heavy mechanized tamping machine with 3-rail lift and tilting tines for packing turnouts, switches, and CMS crossings.

entities.label: Rail Hole Chamfering Equipment
entities.desc: Hydraulic/mechanical bolt hole chamfering tool creating 45° work-hardened bevel to prevent bolt hole star cracks.

entities.label: Compressed Air Petrol Preheating Kit
entities.desc: High-efficiency preheating burner system and mould shoes for Alumino-Thermic weld execution achieving 1000°C flame.

entities.label: Bolt Hole Star Cracking (Defect 135/235)
entities.desc: Radial fatigue cracking emanating from unchamfered fishbolt holes in rail web under heavy impact dynamics.

entities.label: Defective Thermit Weld (Category DFWR)
entities.desc: Severe ultrasonic defect echo exceeding 60% vertical height in rail head, web, or foot of AT weld joint.

entities.label: Wheel Flange Striking CMS Nose
entities.desc: Wheel flange impacts acute nose of crossing caused by excessive check rail clearance (> 45 mm) or tight gauge.
